suite: V2.4.3 — Google Play Billing Restore, Refund & Revocation Security
note: Tests exercise actual imported handlers with mock Redis and Google API doubles. Covers RTDN notifications, revocation state machine, purchase restoration with Google re-verification, exactly-once processing, token hashing, channel isolation, and audit trail. Manual tests requiring Play Console, Cloud Pub/Sub, and RTDN configuration are documented but not run.
